connections.description: Read-only access to Seth's Google Calendar. Serves 'plan my day' and scheduling questions.
connections.name: gcal
connections.setup_notes: Google Cloud project (free) -> enable Google Calendar API -> OAuth consent screen (External) -> OAuth client ID, type Desktop app. Publish app to Production so refresh tokens don't expire after 7 days (free; verification NOT required).

connections.description: Taste profile built from an exported Apple Music/iTunes Library.xml. No account, no network, no cost.
connections.name: apple_music
connections.setup_notes: Mac: Music app -> File -> Library -> Export Library. Windows: iTunes -> File -> Library -> Export Library. Save Library.xml, then: kavibot-connect.py import apple_music <path>.

connections.name: gmail
connections.description: Read-only access to Seth's Gmail: search messages and read message text. Serves mail triage and 'what did X say' questions.
connections.setup_notes: Same Google Cloud project as gcal (free) -> enable the Gmail API -> add the gmail.readonly scope on the OAuth consent screen. Then: kavibot-connect.py connect gmail

connections.name: drive
connections.description: Read-only access to Seth's Google Drive: list files, read metadata, download text files. Binaries are refused, never dumped.
connections.setup_notes: Same Google Cloud project as gcal (free) -> enable the Google Drive API -> add the drive.readonly scope on the OAuth consent screen. Then: kavibot-connect.py connect drive

connections.name: icloud
connections.description: Read-only access to Seth's iCloud Mail (IMAP), Calendar (CalDAV) and Contacts (CardDAV) via Apple ID + app-specific password. No OAuth exists for iCloud; no Apple Developer fee.
connections.setup_notes: Apple ID must have two-factor authentication on. Generate an app-specific password at appleid.apple.com -> Sign-In and Security -> App-Specific Passwords (free). Then: kavibot-connect.py connect icloud (paste the password once into the prompt; it goes straight to the PC vault). Revoke anytime at appleid.apple.com.
